name: Kazuya
source:
"Oh, great, it's you."

Ren’s foster brother. Kazuya has a stubborn, prickly personality. He doesn’t really like Ren, but it’s probably not personal. Kazuya doesn’t like a lot of things.

[From [url=https://peaceful-pastel.itch.io/project-perfectly-normal]itch.io[/url]]
